name: rag-ingestion
description: For each document: fetch it over HTTP, embed it with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and store it in tenant-scoped semantic memory for later memory_search.
author: orch8-io
requires: context.data.documents: array of {id, url, title}; each url returns the document text.
OPENAI_API_KEY in the engine environment (or change api_key_env / base_url / model on embed_document for another OpenAI-compatible provider).
Tenant-scoped memory in namespace context.data.memory_namespace must be permitted by your memory governance policy (see docs/GOVERNED_MEMORY.md).

http_request.body: Orch8 is a durable workflow engine.
